title: Milk Tea Battle
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: In an interactive, adaptive game with at most fifty cups, one player repeatedly distributes at most a fixed number of litres of milk tea among cups, after which opponents empty a window of consecutive cups of a fixed length, at most ten. He may instead end with a last distribution nobody drinks, and within two thousand rounds must guarantee some cup holds essentially the largest amount any strategy can force.
